svg.text: Fig. H4 — The octave bar's bench test on the atom: B_z along a line 5 a0 beside the spin axis
the scan of examples/octave_magnet: a dipole gives two sign changes; more mean more pole sites along the line
Sign changes in the legend. 2p3⁄2 m = ½ gives four at this distance: two N and two S sites along the line, the four-zone pattern seen from the side.
